# DACS Standard vectors

Copied byte for byte from the public DACS Standard repository
(`DACS-Agent-commerce/DACS-Standard`), path `conformance/vectors/security/`,
at commit `04718ddb0cc462899a77b0ddc6184368b2b67df9`.

- `signature-value-encoding-v0.1.json`
- `listing-preserve-unknown-v0.1.json`
- `presence-only-claim-requirement-v0.7.extract.json`: an extract of
  `presence-only-claim-requirement-v0.7.json` holding only the `name`, `requirement`
  and `expected` fields of the vectors this test uses, in the order the test lists them.
  The other two files are byte-identical copies.
